title: High-entropy string detection
description: Random-looking tokens have high Shannon entropy: the character distribution is close to uniform. Strings above an entropy threshold, of sufficient length, and in the right character set are flagged as candidate secrets. Entropy catches secrets that no known-prefix list contains. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers Shannon entropy over candidate strings.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: "hello world", 2: "xK9#mQ2$vL8@nP4!", 3: "AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE"}
import math
from collections import Counter
s = CFG[LEVEL]
freq = Counter(s)
entropy = -sum((c / len(s)) * math.log2(c / len(s)) for c in freq.values())
secret = entropy > 4.0 and len(s) >= 12
print("string: %s | entropy %.2f -> %s" % (s, entropy, "SECRET?" if secret else "clean"))
provenance: Public harvest — documented archive-engineering practice; method fact-checked against standard references.

title: Private-key block detection
description: Private keys in PEM format are wrapped in unmistakable BEGIN/END markers. Scanning for these markers catches keys committed to repositories, the most common serious exposure. Detection triggers immediate rotation because a committed private key is considered compromised. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers PEM BEGIN/END marker scanning.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: "no keys here", 2: "-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----\nMIIE...", 3: "-----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----\nb3Bl..."}
text = CFG[LEVEL]
found = "PRIVATE KEY-----" in text
print("private key block:", "FOUND -> rotate immediately" if found else "none")
provenance: Public harvest — documented archive-engineering practice; method fact-checked against standard references.

title: Allowlist for test fixtures
description: Test suites legitimately contain fake secrets, so an allowlist exempts known fixture values and documented example keys. Allowlist entries require justification and expire, preventing real secrets from hiding behind permanent exemptions. Example keys from documentation are pre-allowlisted. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers exempting documented fake secrets.
